texto: ## 4. 4x3 Borderless Grid

encabezado: Multi-Panel Compositions › 4. 4x3 Borderless Grid
texto: **When to use:** 12 panels telling a story or showing moods — no gaps between panels, seamless mosaic feel.

encabezado: Multi-Panel Compositions › 4. 4x3 Borderless Grid › Template (5-slot format)
texto: ### Template (5-slot format)

encabezado: Multi-Panel Compositions › 4. 4x3 Borderless Grid › Template (5-slot format)
Multi-Panel Compositions › 4. 4x3 Borderless Grid › Template (5-slot format)
texto: **Variables:**

encabezado: Multi-Panel Compositions › 4. 4x3 Borderless Grid › Template (5-slot format)
texto: - `{subject_description}` — who/what appears across panels

encabezado: Multi-Panel Compositions › 4. 4x3 Borderless Grid › Template (5-slot format)
texto: - `{theme}` — overarching concept (e.g., "solitude in a city", "four seasons of a garden")

encabezado: Multi-Panel Compositions › 4. 4x3 Borderless Grid › Template (5-slot format)
texto: - `{panel_1}` through `{panel_12}` — brief shot description per cell

encabezado: Multi-Panel Compositions › 4. 4x3 Borderless Grid › Template (5-slot format)
texto: - `{style_description}` — visual style (e.g., "35mm film grain, desaturated palette")

encabezado: Multi-Panel Compositions › 4. 4x3 Borderless Grid › Template (5-slot format)
texto: - `{mood_arc}` — how energy changes across the grid (e.g., "calm morning to chaotic night")

encabezado: Multi-Panel Compositions › 4. 4x3 Borderless Grid › Template (5-slot format)
texto:
**Recommended size:** 1536x1024 (landscape) — gives each cell enough resolution
**Model:** Nano Banana Pro (handles complex multi-element compositions with thinking mode; no text needed)
**Common pitfalls:**

encabezado: Multi-Panel Compositions › 4. 4x3 Borderless Grid › Template (5-slot format)
texto: - Saying "borderless" is not enough — explicitly state "no white lines, no black borders, no gaps"

encabezado: Multi-Panel Compositions › 4. 4x3 Borderless Grid › Template (5-slot format)
texto: - 12 panels in one image pushes detail limits — keep per-panel descriptions short and visually distinct

encabezado: Multi-Panel Compositions › 4. 4x3 Borderless Grid › Template (5-slot format)
texto: - Without explicit subject consistency instructions, each panel may feature a different person/object

Multi-Panel Compositions › 5. 6-Frame Cinematic Sequence
texto: ## 5. 6-Frame Cinematic Sequence

encabezado: Multi-Panel Compositions › 5. 6-Frame Cinematic Sequence
texto: **When to use:** Fashion editorial or film-style sequence — multiple camera angles of the same scene in one image.

encabezado: Multi-Panel Compositions › 5. 6-Frame Cinematic Sequence › Template (5-slot format)
texto: ### Template (5-slot format)

encabezado: Multi-Panel Compositions › 5. 6-Frame Cinematic Sequence › Template (5-slot format)
texto:
```
Scene: 6-frame cinematic sequence arranged in a 3x2 grid. Dark film-strip aesthetic with thin black borders. {location_description}.

Subject: {subject_description}, wearing {wardrobe_description}. Same person, same outfit, same location across all 6 frames.

Important Details:
Frame 1 (top-left): Top-down bird's eye view — subject seen from directly above, full body visible against ground/floor
Frame 2 (top-center): Low angle looking up — subject towering over camera, dramatic perspective, sky/ceiling visible
Frame 3 (top-right): Wide isolation shot — subject small in frame, vast environment dominates, sense of scale
Frame 4 (bottom-left): Close-up with slight tilt — face and upper body, Dutch angle, intimate intensity
Frame 5 (bottom-center): Motion frame — subject mid-action ({motion_action}), natural motion blur on limbs
Frame 6 (bottom-right): Grounded final — medium shot, subject at rest, direct gaze, resolving the sequence

Photographer reference: {photographer_style}
Lighting: consistent {lighting_description} across all frames

Use Case: fashion editorial, film lookbook, director's shot list visualization
Constraints: same person and wardrobe in every frame, no costume changes, consistent color grading, no text overlays
```

encabezado: Multi-Panel Compositions › 5. 6-Frame Cinematic Sequence › Template (5-slot format)
texto: **Variables:**

encabezado: Multi-Panel Compositions › 5. 6-Frame Cinematic Sequence › Template (5-slot format)
texto: - `{subject_description}` — model details

encabezado: Multi-Panel Compositions › 5. 6-Frame Cinematic Sequence › Template (5-slot format)
texto: - `{wardrobe_description}` — clothing

encabezado: Multi-Panel Compositions › 5. 6-Frame Cinematic Sequence › Template (5-slot format)
texto: - `{location_description}` — setting

encabezado: Multi-Panel Compositions › 5. 6-Frame Cinematic Sequence › Template (5-slot format)
texto: - `{motion_action}` — what the motion frame captures (e.g., "walking forward", "turning sharply", "jumping")

encabezado: Multi-Panel Compositions › 5. 6-Frame Cinematic Sequence › Template (5-slot format)
texto: - `{photographer_style}` — (e.g., "Peter Lindbergh desaturated realism", "Helmut Newton dramatic contrast")

encabezado: Multi-Panel Compositions › 5. 6-Frame Cinematic Sequence › Template (5-slot format)
texto: - `{lighting_description}` — (e.g., "overcast natural light, soft shadows")

encabezado: Multi-Panel Compositions › 5. 6-Frame Cinematic Sequence › Template (5-slot format)
texto:
**Recommended size:** 1536x1024 (landscape, 3x2 grid)
**Model:** GPT Image 2 `quality: medium` or Nano Banana Pro
**Common pitfalls:**

encabezado: Multi-Panel Compositions › 5. 6-Frame Cinematic Sequence › Template (5-slot format)
texto: - Not naming each frame explicitly — "various angles" is too vague, the model needs per-frame instructions

encabezado: Multi-Panel Compositions › 5. 6-Frame Cinematic Sequence › Template (5-slot format)
texto: - Top-down and low-angle in the same grid confuse the model if you don't anchor each frame to a grid position

encabezado: Multi-Panel Compositions › 5. 6-Frame Cinematic Sequence › Template (5-slot format)
texto: - Motion blur instruction must be specific ("blur on hands and feet") or the model applies blur everywhere

encabezado: Multi-Panel Compositions › 5. 6-Frame Cinematic Sequence › Template (5-slot format)

texto: ## 6. Before/After Split

encabezado: Multi-Panel Compositions › 6. Before/After Split
texto: **When to use:** Product transformation, makeover, time comparison, renovation — two states side by side.

encabezado: Multi-Panel Compositions › 6. Before/After Split › Template (5-slot format)
texto: ### Template (5-slot format)

encabezado: Multi-Panel Compositions › 6. Before/After Split › Template (5-slot format)
Multi-Panel Compositions › 6. Before/After Split › Template (5-slot format)
texto: **Variables:**

encabezado: Multi-Panel Compositions › 6. Before/After Split › Template (5-slot format)
texto: - `{subject_description}` — what is being compared

encabezado: Multi-Panel Compositions › 6. Before/After Split › Template (5-slot format)
texto: - `{before_description}` / `{before_condition}` — left side state (e.g., "faded, cracked wall with peeling paint")

encabezado: Multi-Panel Compositions › 6. Before/After Split › Template (5-slot format)
texto: - `{after_description}` / `{after_condition}` — right side state (e.g., "freshly painted wall, smooth finish, vibrant color")

encabezado: Multi-Panel Compositions › 6. Before/After Split › Template (5-slot format)
texto: - `{divider_style}` — "thin white line" / "subtle gradient blend" / "sharp vertical cut"

encabezado: Multi-Panel Compositions › 6. Before/After Split › Template (5-slot format)
texto: - `{transition_style}` — "clean and abrupt" / "natural, as if wiping away"

encabezado: Multi-Panel Compositions › 6. Before/After Split › Template (5-slot format)
texto: - `{use_case}` — "product marketing", "renovation portfolio", "skincare results"

encabezado: Multi-Panel Compositions › 6. Before/After Split › Template (5-slot format)
texto:
**Recommended size:** 1536x1024 (landscape — gives each half a portrait-like proportion)
**Model:** GPT Image 2 `quality: medium` — for text labels ("BEFORE" / "AFTER"), use `quality: high`
**Common pitfalls:**

encabezado: Multi-Panel Compositions › 6. Before/After Split › Template (5-slot format)
texto: - Not specifying "same camera angle both sides" — model may show two completely different viewpoints

encabezado: Multi-Panel Compositions › 6. Before/After Split › Template (5-slot format)
texto: - Without a visible divider, the two halves can merge into one ambiguous scene

encabezado: Multi-Panel Compositions › 6. Before/After Split › Template (5-slot format)
texto: - Left/right assignment matters — always state which side is before and which is after

encabezado: Multi-Panel Compositions › 6. Before/After Split › Template (5-slot format)
